title: eludite.agents.provider_models input
description: List a server's models through the adapter's own code path (`eludite-openai-acp models`), off the UI thread: `GET {baseUrl}/models` with a 30 s timeout, or the provider's catalog. Give `name` for a saved server (its base url, headers, catalog and stored key), or `baseUrl` (and `apiKey`) for one being added; `baseUrl` and `apiKey` given with `name` override the saved ones. Execute: it makes a network call.

name.description: The server's name: unique, shown as the agent's name in the Agents window, and the credential key `provider:<name>`.

baseUrl.description: The API root ending in the version segment, such as `http://localhost:8080/v1` (llama.cpp) or `https://openrouter.ai/api/v1`; the adapter appends `/models` and `/chat/completions` and strips one trailing slash.

apiKey.description: The key to try; never stored by this command.
